main_text.l: CAPUT VII.
DE ANTONINO, CARACALLA,
MACRINO, & HELIOGA-
BALO.
Anni funt 11. ad A.C. 223.
ANTONINUS, Caracalla à barbaro vellitu
dictus, nihil laude digni, seu pace intra hostes,
quos regnavit annos, gessit. Belligeratum
est contra Armenios, Parthos & Germanos.
Armenii arma cepere, postquam Regem suum,
specie amicitiæ evocatum, cum Augaro Ofroe-
norum detentum audivissent: contra quos curat
Theocritus, ex servo natus, missus fuisset, ab
iisdem victus, magnam cladem accepit. De re-
liquis vide in suis locis. Inter pacifica opera
sunt, Medicorum, quod patris mortem non acce-
leraverunt; fatris Getæ, quem in finu matris Iulia
interfecit; Papiniani, quod fratris cædem appro-
bare nollet; viginti millium, quod Getæ fave-
rent; Augæ, qui in Certaminibus DCCLXXXII
coronas obtinuerat; cædes Vestalis Clodiæ fra-
prum: incestus cum matre commissio: exercitatio
in Alexandrinos, quod se Oedipum, matrem
locastam vocarent, crudelitas: vana Alexandri
Magni in rebus bellicis imitatio: In Ario-
licos odium; iniquissimæ in ulum ædificiorum
exactiones: Immensa in milites & alienatores
liberalitas: monetæ adulterinæ percussio:
arum ab inferis revocatio: Sempronii Rufi
Eunuchi fastigium; & Senatus in Iudiciis Iudi-ci-um.

page.notes: The text is partly damaged and blurred on the right edge; the marginal notes at right are largely illegible. Readings in the right-hand portion of lines 11–24 are doubtful and some words were reconstructed from context where the scan is obscured. Catchword-like stray marks at bottom right ("Caʀᴀ") are not legible.
